title: Bar Salts Watermelon 10ml Longfill E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Enjoy the fresh, fruity taste of Bar Salts’ Watermelon in a unique flavour concentrate that makes mixing your own DIY e-liquid a breeze, even for newcomers. With their collection of ten deliciously distinct concentrate flavours, Vampire Vape Bar Salts longfills offer the ultimate DIY experience. Just add a 10ml Nic Shot (or no nicotine) and a VG/PG base mix, shake it up and enjoy a blend that’s uniquely yours, built on Bar Salts' hugely popular flavours. What are Longfills? Vampire Vape Bar Salts Longfill e-liquids come with 10ml of flavour concentrate in a 60ml bottle, letting you add your preferred amount of nicotine shots (optional) and PG/VG base e-liquid . This means you have full control over the strength and ratio of your e-liquid. Unlike shortfills, which only go up to 3mg (with 1 x nic shot in a 50ml shortfill bottle), Longfills can be mixed to 0mg, 1.5mg, 3mg, and 6mg strengths depending on how many nicotine shots you add. How to Mix Your Longfill: Understand Your Longfill: Each bottle contains 10ml of flavour concentrate in a 60ml bottle. Choose the Right Nicotine Shot: For 1.5mg Strength: Add half a 10ml 18mg nicotine shot. For 3mg Strength: Add one 10ml 18mg nicotine shot. For 6mg Strength: Add two 10ml 18mg nicotine shots (add less PG/VG Base Mix to make space). Add Base Mix: Top up the bottle with a PG/VG base mix to create 60ml of e-liquid. Shake Well: Shake the bottle vigorously for a few minutes to ensure even distribution. Let it Steep (Optional): Allow the mixed liquid to steep for a few hours or overnight to enhance flavour. Recommended Kits: Depending upon the type of VG/PG Base E-liquid you choose, you can create an e-liquid that perfectly suits your device and vaping style. Use a 70/30 base mix to create a High-VG e-liquid that’s ideal for advanced vape kits and sub-ohm coils , and DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping. Use a 50/50 Base mix to create a balanced e-liquid suitable for Pod Kits , Starter Kits and high-resistance coils, and MTL (mouth-to-lung) or RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping. Troubleshooting: Burnt Taste? Ensure you are using the correct kit and that the e-liquid is mixed properly.
